title: Homily LXV
subtitle: Matthew 20:17-19
author: chrysostom
excerpt: “And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of Man shall be…

footnotes.9: Mark x. 32; comp. Mark ix. 32, and Luke xviii. 34.
footnotes.17: [The longer reading is here accepted. The R.V. follows a briefer reading here and in verse 23.—R.]
footnotes.19: Matt. xx. 23. [The latter clause is omitted in the R.V.]
footnotes.22: Matt. xvi. 19. [This peculiar reading and rendering is commented on in the note on Homily LIV. 3.—R.]
footnotes.31: [The form of this clause in Greek differs from that of all our New Testament mss.—R.]
footnotes.32: Matt. xx. 25–27. [The variations in text, especially in verse 27, are peculiar; compare with the A.V. and R.V.—R.]
